exposure: Different heart disease diagnoses (e.g., pulmonary arterial hypertension, congenital heart disease, valvular heart disease)
Pregnant women with different heart disease diagnoses
finding: Despite an increase in high-risk pregnancies over the study period, rates of maternal mortality or heart failure in pregnant women with heart disease declined from 2010 onwards.
mod_finding: Delivery was by Caesarean section in 44% of the cohort.
